name: Thanos (Deathless)

abilityDetails.Protection: Tüm kaynaklardan alınan hasarı belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Counterpunch: Bir saldırıyı bloklarken şarj harcayarak kısa süreli Unstoppable kazanır ve anında karşı saldırı yapılabilir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Panic: Etkilenen şampiyonlar Kaçış (Evade) yapamaz veya saldırıları ıskalatamaz.
abilityDetails.Pulverize: Bir Armor Up etkisini kaldırır ve doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Corrosion: Aktifken fiziksel hasar verir; hedefin zırhı azaldıkça bu hasar %100'e kadar artar.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Shattered: Yeni Zırh Kırma etkilerini engeller ve Armor Up etkilerinin yetenek doğruluğunu %200 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Genesis: Bu şampiyon, rakibin aldığı hasarın belirtilen kısmını pasif olarak kendine can olarak kazanır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloğuna vurma — pasif durdurulamaz kazanıp anında karşılık verir. Savaş gücü oranı kalıcı +%15 artmış (nekrotik enerjiyle daha da artar, +%75'e kadar), özel saldırıları çok hızlı doldurur. E2 bloklanamaz (blok yeterliliğini %80 azaltır), 0,75sn'de 2 kaçış anlık corrosion tetikler. Durdurulamaza dirençli şampiyonlar (Dust, Beta Ray Bill, Chee'ilth) en iyisi; güç kontrolcüleri E2'sini önler; nötralize energize bonusunu kaldırır; sık özel saldırı kullandığı için iğne (sting) efektli şampiyonlar da iyi.
signatureAbility:
Death Arrives All The Same
Personal effects expire up to [10 - 40]% more slowly and gain up to 100% increased Ability Accuracy, scaling with Necrotic Energy. These bonuses have half potency at zero Energy.
At the start of Thanos's first fight each Quest as an Attacker and each fight as a Defender, he gains [5 - 30] Necrotic Energy. This does not grant Counterpunch Charges and cannot happen again until Thanos's teammates win a fight.
Personal Protections gain +1% flat potency per Necrotic Energy.

abilitySections.title: Titan Protocol
content: Thanos's long reign in deep space has twisted his Eternal Physiology, granting him Immuity to Coldsnap, Frostbite, and Poison.

The first time each fight Thanos loses a multiple of 25% of his Max Health, he gains a 40% Protection Passive for 2 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks and unaffected by Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Necrotic Energy - Max: 60
content: Gain +1 Necrotic Energy when landing a hit. As a Defender, gain +2 when an Opponent strikes Thanos or his Block.

Thanos starts each fight with an indefinite Energize Buff, increasing his Combat Power Rate by 15%, increased by +0.5% flat per Necrotic Energy, or by +1% flat as a Defender. The potency of this Buff can only be modified by Thanos.
When this Energize is removed or prevented, it is restored after 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Unstoppable Scion of Chaos
content: For every 10 Necrotic Energy he would gain, Thanos gains a Counterpunch Charge for 24 seconds, or 12 seconds as a Defender. Max stacks: 2.
Thanos does not spend Charges while Unstoppable, executing a Well-Timed Block, or when Blocking non-final hits of Special Attacks.
If Thanos would gain a Counterpunch Charge while at max stacks, he instead gains an Unstoppable Passive for 3 seconds.
Gaining Unstoppable inflicts a Panic Debuff for 5 seconds.
Interrupting the Opponent's attacks with a Heavy Attack or while Unstoppable grants +5 Necrotic Energy and pauses personal Furies and Armor Shattered for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Master of War - Heavy Attack
content: Charging a Heavy Attack after landing a non-Combo Ending Attack inflicts a Stun Passive for 0.75 seconds.
Each hit either Pulverizes one Armor Up effect if any are active or inflicts an Instant Corrosion if not, both dealing [1,818.6] damage.

On the final hit, or when canceling this attack with Special Attack 1 or 2, consume 30 Necrotic Energy to inflict a non-stacking [5,107.14] Armor Break Debuff and an Armor Shattered Debuff for 16 seconds.
Thanos does not inflict Armor Shattered if it is already active with more than 25% of its duration remaining.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[2,727.9] for 16 seconds. Max stacks: 8.
The first hit consumes 20 Necrotic Energy. Each subsequent hit has a 40% chance to grant an additional Fury. If Energy was consumed, the chance is 100% instead.
After the final hit, gain a non-stacking Genesis Passive for 10 seconds, allowing Thanos to Passively Regenerate 2% of all damage taken by the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Some projectiles in this attack are nothing but a bad dream. The real ones ignore 80% of the Opponent's Block Proficiency and Armor Rating.
Each hit inflicts a [4,546.5] Corrosion Debuff for 8 seconds and consumes 15 Necrotic Energy to apply two additional Debuffs.

As a Defender, Thanos consumes 10 Necrotic Energy to start a 0.75 second timer when the Opponent Dodges backwards during this Attack. Dodging again while this timer is active inflicts an Instant [4,546.5] Corrosion.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: The first time each fight this attack is used, Thanos draws on the Evolution Stone to permanently increase his maximum Necrotic Energy by +20. Additionally, he gains one more Energy when striking the Opponent with Medium Attacks.
Inflict an indefinite Corrosion Passive, dealing [909.3] Physical Damage per second. Max stacks: 10.

At the start of Thanos's first fight each Quest as an Attacker and each fight as a Defender, he gains [5 - 30] Necrotic Energy. This does not grant Counterpunch Charges and cannot happen again until Thanos's teammates win a fight.
Personal Protections gain +1% flat potency per Necrotic Energy.
